# CONTRIBUTING starts a claim's 7 days at the assignment, though the claim reserves the ticket

## Context

`CONTRIBUTING.md` §3, step 3 (line 131) frees a ticket "if a ticket is assigned and we do not receive any feedback from the assignee (e.g. via a comment) within 7 days". That rule dates from 2025-10-09 (#7426). The claim responder came later (#19211, 2026-09-25). Its reply tells the first claimant to start right away, and a maintainer's assignment only confirms the claim. The operator, 2026-11-08: "the claim workflow should count. we added it post the 7 days rule. an assignment is fully optional."

Read literally, the rule kept #24 reserved until Nov 12: it was claimed on Oct 22 and assigned only on Nov 5. #19537, claimed and assigned on Oct 12, had already lapsed.

## The Problem

One reservation runs on two clocks. The same step tells a claimant the ticket "is yours: start right away", says "An assignment is what protects your time", and then starts the 7 days at an assignment that can come weeks later, or never.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: the operator's sentence above, and the claim responder's header (`.github/workflows/claim-responder.yml`): "It never assigns: a maintainer confirms the assignment, and that step is also what screens out accounts that spray claims."
- The responder's reply links this step as "How claims work", so it is the page every claimant reads.

## The Fix

Step 3 says that the first claim reserves the ticket from the automatic reply. The claim lapses after 7 days without a word from the claimant, and any comment on the ticket restarts the 7 days. A maintainer's assignment confirms the claim, and a maintainer can release a claim from an account that sprays them. The sentence calling an assignment what protects your time goes.

The responder has to agree with the text. `earlierClaim` in `buildScripts/util/claimResponse.mjs` measured the 7 days from the claim comment and renewed them only with another claim-shaped comment, so a plain progress note lapsed (Sophie's falsifier on #20617). It now measures them from the claimant's latest comment.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Step 3 starts the 7 days at the claim and restarts them with any comment from the claimant.
- [ ] Step 3 names the assignment as the claim's confirmation, not as the reservation.
- [ ] The claim responder holds a claim for 7 days from the claimant's latest comment. A progress note renews it, and 7 days of silence free it (unit: claim on Oct 31, progress on Nov 7, a second claim on Nov 8 is told the ticket is taken).

## Out of Scope

- The responder's reply text.
- #24's handover, which is with Ada.
